title: Ethical Risk Assessment of the Data Harnessing Process of LLM supported on Consensus of Well-known Multi-Ethical Frameworks
reasoning: The paper is entirely focused on creating an 'Ethical Risk Scoring' (ERS) mechanism grounded in ten foundational ethical theories (including Utilitarianism, Deontology, Virtue Ethics, and Ethics of Care) to quantitatively assess the ethical integrity of Large Language Models.
